assertion.statement: The actual finite Heegner construction has points of every permitted old conductor d over H_d, with the fixed split level orientations and compatible points under all permitted conductor raises.
assertion.objects: The fixed imaginary quadratic K and X0(N) used with the actual elliptic quotient in main3720–3740 and3798–3820.
assertion.hypotheses: All level primes split in K, d is prime to2ND_K, units are plus/minus1 as in the actual setup, and each new prime avoids6dND_K and prior new primes.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such old conductor and permitted finite sequence of new conductor primes.
assertion.parameter_range: Classical split-level case N1=1, N0=N of the source; no claim for arbitrary inadmissible embeddings.
assertion.uniformity: The same level orientations and the specified compatible ideal construction are used at each conductor.
assertion.constants: No numerical multiplier or analytic estimate is imported.
assertion.normalizations: Source ideal-class parametrization and normalized CM embedding; cyclic level subgroup a*N^-1/a.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Does not assert inert reduction, extension of modular parametrizations, Atkin–Lehner eigenvalues, or a new proof of CM reciprocity.
assertion.limit_order: Choose admissible level data and the normalized CM point before raising conductors and applying the separate norm theorem.

use.reason: The norm theorem requires compatible CM points; this source import supplies that prerequisite rather than deducing it from the norm conclusion.
use.shared_contract_justification: Main3798–3820 and the supporting note13–15 describe the identical finite Heegner point family, fixed level orientations and conductor conditions.

supplier.statement: In the all-split Heegner case with (c,N)=1, proper invertible order ideals and a cyclic level-N ideal define classical CM points on X0(N) over H_c, depending only on the ideal class. Normalized embeddings carry the Shimura reciprocity action, and the specified ideal-intersection construction gives compatible conductor-raising points outside6cND_K.
